scope: variable-count full-model mixed NEC / dense-INT8 / dense-FP16 allocation predicted from single-layer end-to-end logit probes

method.name: Fisher quadratic interaction proxy with conditional beam, swap search, and exact shortlist refinement
method.proxy_objective: second-order dense-teacher KL and NLL Taylor expansion in logit space
method.allocation_objective: maximize actual serialized NEC plus dense-INT8 artifact savings subject to measured refinement PPL and the hard non-NEC layer cap; compare candidates on independent held-out data
method.proxy_search_strategy: conditional fixed-cardinality Fisher searches across allowed counts
method.max_ppl_constraint_applied_to: proxy and exact-refinement selection samples; held-out PPL is the independent check
method.exact_refinement_selection_rule: among candidates meeting max_ppl on the refinement sample, maximize bytes saved using actual checkpoint file sizes; if none pass, select the lowest-PPL candidate and mark infeasible

storage.scope: candidate layers only; dense FP16 tensor payload plus actual serialized NEC checkpoint files
storage.scope_ratio_note: Scoped weight-storage ratio only. It uses exact dense tensor payload bytes and actual checkpoint file sizes; package-level metadata and loader/runtime files are outside this layer-weight accounting.
storage.whole_model_ratio_note: Measured by summing every serialized file in the rebuilt deployable package, including retained model tensors, NEC and INT8 artifacts, metadata, and loader code.
storage.compression_goal_assessment: 10x aspiration not met; report the measured ratio and current representation limit

independent_sensitivity_baseline.selection_rule: for each allowed count, choose the individually lowest singleton-KL layers; among proxy-feasible masks, select the largest exact serialized-byte savings
independent_sensitivity_baseline.warning: baseline ignores interactions and is not the allocator's objective
